name: B10-0432/2026 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission regulation amending Annex XVII to Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 of the European Parliament and of the Council concerning the Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) as regards lead in gunshot
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opposition to a draft European Commission rule that would restrict lead in gunshot under the chemicals regulation known as REACH. The Parliament says the Commission has not properly checked whether affordable alternatives exist, what the economic impact would be, and how hunters, sport shooters, gunsmiths and historic firearms would be affected. It asks the Commission to withdraw the draft and come back with a new one after a fuller assessment.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament rejects the draft rule and asks for a new one.
- **Who it affects:** Hunters, sport shooters, gunsmiths, ammunition makers and shooting ranges.
- **What happens next:** The Commission is asked to withdraw the draft and reassess before resubmitting.
